description: Sabaragamuwa Province - The Sabaragamuwa Provincial Appropriation Statute Nos. 04, 05.06 and 07 of 2015
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the enactment of an Appropriation Statute (No. 04 of 2015) for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, which is a legislative instrument authorizing government expenditure, raising loans, and making financial provisions. It establishes legal frameworks for budgetary matters, expenditure limits, and financial procedures, falling squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" classification for new laws, acts, and statutory instruments.
